# Snapshot fixtures

`linkoping.json` is a fixture-backed Snapshot for whole-app tests and the local
demo file in `public/snapshots/`. It composes observed ICA and Hemköp source
field examples with synthetic product/promotion associations and
validity-boundary rows; it is not a captured live Snapshot. The public file
identifies Hemköp as `hemkop-fixture`, and the app labels it as example data.
